items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the existence of an open subspace classifying exactly the base changes over which the direct image is a finite locally free module of rank r in degree i (source lines 6764-6785, label lemma-open-where-cohomology-in-degree-i-rank-r-geometric). The proof is a short but complete reduction: the whole content is to supply the perfectness and base change compatibility of K and then transfer the perfect openness criterion along the base change identification; both inputs are same-chapter citations and every step is argued in-span.
